title: Use shared VideoML animation demos without duplicate implementations
description:
## Behavior and canonical plan
Babulus consumes the seven shared VideoML animation demos without a second implementation. Canonical packet VideoML/toolchain videoml-ca79a1 (P06), initiative videoml-dbc2b1 D03. Migrate AnimeHarnessDemo, ThreeOrbit, LottieBadge, D3BarChart, P5Particles, TextEffects and MixAndMatchDemo; retain old Babulus names as documented aliases for one minor release.

```gherkin
Feature: Shared portable animation demos
  Scenario: Existing Babulus demo renders through the shared library
    Given an existing animation demo using its established component name
    When Babulus renders requested frames with the packed VideoML standard library
    Then the shared implementation produces the demo visuals
    And no private Babulus implementation or paid service is required
  Scenario: VideoML uses the same demo independently
    Given the shared demo and its declared local assets
    When a standalone VideoML consumer renders repeated and backward frames
    Then the output is deterministic in the pinned environment
```

## Implementation acceptance
Read AGENTS and CONTRIBUTING_AGENT before editing. Gherkin first; preserve existing animation behavior scenarios. Seven real browser captures, package-consumer smoke, provenance and required quality gates. Primary reviews evidence. Do not commit Babulus changes without the separately required user approval; leave the concrete tested diff reviewable. No cloud resources or full Studio build installs without resource-slot coordination.

comments.text: P06 source migration now covers seven shared demos and legacy aliases; no commit or deployment. Static tests and targeted pure timing/cancellation checks passed. Locks, browser rendering, existing animation behavior suite and packed consumer remain unverified because shared disk is below8GiB floor. VideoML packet videoml-ca79a1 records the capacity blocker. Preserve changes for review; do not claim migration complete or commit without required approval.
